text:
Rhea: Customer follow-up: they want a single chat turn that can run small sequences of calls (some sequences ordered, sequences run in parallel), a shared retry pool that can be reallocated at runtime, per-call timeouts, and clear backpressure signals for streaming UIs.
Tom: TLDR API idea: an `invoke_plan` with `sequences[]` where each sequence is ordered, and a `retry_pool` (global_retry_budget) that the runtime can spend across sequences. Include per-call `timeout_ms`, `idempotency_key`, and `backpressure_hint`: `buffer|drop|throttle`. Example: ```json
{
  "sequences": [
    { "seq_id": "s1", "ordered": true, "calls": [ { "tool": "get_price", "timeout_ms": 300 }, { "tool": "reserve", "timeout_ms": 800 } ] },
    { "seq_id": "s2", "ordered": true, "calls": [ { "tool": "score", "timeout_ms": 200 } ] }
  ],
  "global_retry_budget": 3,
  "emit_partial": true
}
```
Ibrahim: MVP suggestion: support ordered sequences (strict within sequence) and parallel sequences (sequences start concurrently). Runtime can consume `global_retry_budget` across sequences; per-call `retries_allowed` can override but must still count against pool. No cross-sequence transactions in MVP. Default `max_concurrency` = 3, account cap = 6.
Nia: Observability: require `trace_id` for the whole chat turn, and per-call fields: `attempts`, `latency_ms`, `bytes`, `cost_units`, `backpressure_state` (buffered|dropped|streamed). Add per-turn summary: total_calls, retries_used, dropped_events.
Tom: Safety note: require `idempotency_key` for any call that requests retries. Runtime should add a response warning when retries consumed on a non-idempotent call.
Rhea: UX: streaming clients must handle interleaved sequence events. Document that ordered sequences guarantee within-sequence ordering but cross-sequence emission is driven by completion time and backpressure hints.
Ibrahim: Perf/cost: parallel sequences multiply egress and backend load. Sara/infra should model cost curves for concurrency 1/3/6 and measure p95 latency.
Nia: Telemetry addition: expose `buffer_length` and `dropped_count` metrics so customers can tune `backpressure_hint`. Also include per-call `replacement_event` if a placeholder was emitted and later replaced.
Tom: Launch criteria: RFC + JSON schema + SDK examples (JS streaming + Python), perf tests hitting p95 targets, per-call telemetry validated, security outbound-review, and one enterprise canary.
deploy-bot: Created INF-2801: "invoke-plan-sequences-and-retry-pool RFC" assigned to Ibrahim, Tom, Nia.
Rhea: Action items: Ibrahim+Tom draft RFC with exact schema and examples; Nia to define telemetry and acceptance tests; infra to run perf sims. Target: RFC in 2 weeks, internal alpha in 6 weeks.
infra-bot: Created task INF-2802: "simulate 1000 concurrent turns with 2-3 sequences" assigned to infra.
Rhea: Thanks all  we'll review RFC in product sync.
